data.name: HomeLead
data.value: A responsive university attendance management foundation with authentication, localization, theming, and a replaceable face verification boundary.

data.name: CleanArchitectureText
data.value: Domain, application, infrastructure, and web responsibilities are separated so future attendance modules can grow without coupling to MVC.

data.name: IdentityFoundationText
data.value: Cookie authentication, role-based dashboards, safe return URLs, antiforgery validation, and disabled-account handling are prepared.

data.name: FaceSpikeText
data.value: The web app depends on an engine abstraction and automated tests use a deterministic fake engine without cameras or biometric files.

data.name: FoundationWorkflowText
data.value: These rows describe Sprint 1 infrastructure status, not production attendance analytics.

data.value: Arabic and English support across future modules

data.name: FutureAttendanceVerification
data.value: One-to-one attendance verification in a future sprint

data.name: PrivacyLead
data.value: This notice explains the intended biometric processing boundaries for the graduation project without making unsupported legal claims.

data.name: PrivacyFaceDataText
data.value: Face data is intended only for one-to-one identity verification during attendance workflows. Sprint 1 does not perform production attendance verification.

data.name: PrivacyStorageText
data.value: The planned system should store a face template where possible and avoid permanent storage of raw face images unless a documented, approved operational need exists.

data.name: PrivacyAccessText
data.value: Access to biometric templates must be restricted to authorized services and administrators with a legitimate operational reason.

data.name: PrivacySprintLimitText
data.value: This sprint contains architecture, documentation, a fake test engine, and a POC harness. It does not enroll real production faces or mark attendance.
